tokens.name: gelb
tokens.usage: Bright yellow for surfaces with black on top: primary button, the timetable mat, the selected group, the closure banner, the phone icon circle. Never text on a light background.

tokens.name: gelb-ink
tokens.usage: Yellow as a graphic: the 국술원 sign and list bullets in articles. A touch deeper in light mode so it holds on light backgrounds. (The logo stays bright gelb and gets a thin black outline in light mode instead.)

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent text such as the phone number and the Kuk Sool Won link: black in light mode (yellow text is unreadable there), yellow in dark mode.

tokens.name: btn-edge
tokens.usage: Button edge: 1px black on light backgrounds (yellow alone has no edge there), none on dark where the yellow stands out by itself.

tokens.name: gelb-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of the yellow button.

tokens.name: jade
tokens.usage: Tai Chi, Qi Gong and breathing: Tai Chi slots in the timetable (white text), focus ring. Calm counterpart to the yellow.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (cool hall-white; near-black in dark).

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Text and borders on bg and card.

tokens.name: stein
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, meta lines, captions, labels in definition lists.

tokens.name: linie
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows, timetable hour lines, quiet borders.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised panels: timetable, CMS preview cards, stepper fields.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Bands that carry the brand: Kuk Sool Won half, contact band, footer, mobile bar. One flat step away from the page (darker in light, lighter in dark); no shadow, no radius.

tokens.name: panel-fg
tokens.usage: Text on panel.

tokens.name: tc-bg
tokens.usage: Tai Chi half and Tai Chi page header background.

tokens.name: tc-fg
tokens.usage: Text on tc-bg.

tokens.name: slot-k
tokens.usage: Kuk Sool Won slots in the timetable (inverts in dark so they stay strong on the dark card).

tokens.name: slot-k-fg
tokens.usage: Text on slot-k.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Medal dot: 1st place. Data colour only, never decoration.

tokens.name: silber
tokens.usage: Medal dot: 2nd place.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Medal dot: 3rd place.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Home page headline only. Fluid clamp(3.2rem, 7.5vw, 8.6rem); set with font-stretch: 62% (class .cond).

styles.name: display-phone
styles.usage: The phone number in the contact band (yellow on black, tabular figures).

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Kuk Sool Won half, contact band and post titles (fluid up to 4.4-4.6rem).

styles.name: heading-section
styles.usage: Section heading above the yellow rule (.sec-h); fluid clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.2rem).

styles.name: display-taichi
styles.sample: Tai Chi, Qi Gong und Atemschulung
styles.usage: The Tai Chi voice: wide and light (class .wide). Never mixed with condensed in one heading.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Kuk Sool Won für Kinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene.
styles.usage: Intro under the hero headline and on the master section.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: News row titles, timetable detail heading (1.3-1.5rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Leichte Bewegungen aus der eigenen Schrittlänge, immer aus einem sicheren Stand.
styles.usage: All running text; keep lines under ~68ch.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Dates, footer links, legends (tabular figures for dates and times).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Kind and place above a news title, captions. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: hangul-mark
styles.usage: The art's own name (Kuk Sool Won) in yellow above the Kuk Sool Won heading. The font file holds only these three glyphs.

spacing.note: Section rhythm in px; the side gutter is fluid clamp(16px, 4vw, 64px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between timetable columns, list item spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Week-panel inner padding, legend gaps, the yellow mat offset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gaps in news rows and footers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Column gap between photo and text, hero columns.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of content sections.

tokens.name: gutter-min
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: gutter-max
tokens.usage: Side gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: max-width
tokens.usage: Content width; running text keeps its own ch limit.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Timetable slots.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, photos, panels, inputs. The system is nearly square: no pills, no large radii.

stroke.note: Line widths; the yellow rule is the system's main structural device.

tokens.name: rule-accent
tokens.usage: Section rule in the text colour (fg): under section headings and post titles, above the hero detail panel. Not yellow (yellow is for actions, selection and training times).

tokens.name: rule-side
tokens.usage: Yellow side rule in the contact band.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Black/fg border of the timetable panel and buttons.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers (linie).

tokens.name: shadow-mat
tokens.usage: The yellow mat behind the timetable panel (8px on phones). The only shadow in the system; no soft grey shadows.
